pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Run Beam on your own computer, finish setup, name your business and try each role.

pages.title: People, roles and teams
pages.summary: Invite staff, give them roles, group them in teams, and remove or restore access.

pages.title: Sources and courses
pages.summary: Upload your procedures, build a course from them, and send each revision for review.

pages.title: Review and publish
pages.summary: Publish or return a revision, choose who moves to it, and decide when a source changes.

pages.title: Assign and follow up
pages.summary: Assign courses and role paths, work the overdue, retry and renewal queues, and record offline training.

pages.title: Learning in Beam
pages.summary: What staff see: lessons that resume anywhere, quizzes, practical evidence, practice and certificates.

pages.title: Reports and records
pages.summary: See who completed which revision, filter the training report and download it as CSV.

pages.title: Agent work
pages.summary: Let your own agent prepare drafts, plans and reminders that you approve or decline.

pages.title: Move in from TalentLMS
pages.summary: Bring your TalentLMS course list and course reports across as labelled history, with a preview and undo.

pages.title: Backup and restore
pages.summary: Export everything to one archive, restore it into a fresh copy, and let your staff back in.
